title: Prove sharp c=6 endpoint chain windows (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Unpaidmoon's #7099 asks which T2 endpoint pairs are joined by a weight-3 chain on the six-source c=6 diagonal. The answer on [4,18] is empty. This package proves the sharp window of every separation-3 family and supplies explicit attaining words.

```text
S(s) = q_s + q_(39-s)
weight-3 steps preserve each coordinate's base
L low coordinates require at least 5L letters in a suffix of length s-3
least window start = max(4, 3+5L)
```

Claim type: scoped written mathematical proof with an exhaustive finite certificate. On T2's longest window [8,18], exactly 720 of 21,600 endpoint pairs are joined. The package also proves that weight-3 at (0,9) coexists with a window [s0,18] exactly when s0 >= 8. This last threshold extends the advance claim's scope, as recorded in the [progress update](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19537481).

Only `research/six-source-c6-chain-windows/` is added. The window theorem, threshold and verifier were produced by Nick Petalas. Credit is retained for unpaidmoon #7099/#7029/#7042 and the merged centre-classification package; Nick Petalas #4231/#4248/#6107; Ross Richardson #934/#943; and JosieElliston #6141.

## Evidence

- Before: #7099 leaves the T2 endpoint relation open on [4,18], and #7029 excludes the joint (0,9) hypothesis using that full window.
- After: a suffix-count proof gives sharp family windows; a graph-to-word argument proves the finite state graph is exact. Exhaustive backward and forward reachability agree on all six joined-pair counts. Seven stored words pass literal prefix-count checks. A separately written reverse graph agrees on all six pair counts, and five verifier mutations were rejected locally.

Reproduce from the repository root with CPython 3.12.15 and the standard library:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/six-source-c6-chain-windows/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -O -W error -B research/six-source-c6-chain-windows/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/six-source-c6-chain-windows/verify.py --print-witnesses
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/six-source-c6-chain-windows
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/six-source-c6-chain-windows --check-source-history --check-modes
```

At head `af3647d85d6f52956b1423ec8b22646f0deac196`, the two registered commands pass locally, each below 30 seconds. The package runner prints `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE`. The committed-byte, source-history and mode check prints `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES` for all six package files and the one declared input. The scientific marker is:

```text
PASS_SIX_SOURCE_C6_CHAIN_WINDOWS states=77220 steps=644820 first=[(0, 4), (1, 8), (2, 13), (3, 18)] joined=[360, 720, 20, 360, 1080, 2400] forward=6 starts09=[0, 0, 0, 0, 180, 480] witnesses=7 controls=7 inputs=1
```

`SOURCES.json` binds the interface README, the original task catalogue and the selected-record context to main `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`. The question source is #7099 at `123e6808f2d1381e5ab07d128e69c52a98ef0a1a`. The T1 by-product, 2,400 pairs, agrees with #7099; the 700 endpoint states and six family sizes agree with #7029. These arise inside the new window computation, without replaying either predecessor's package.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

The result fixes six sources, c=6, length 36 and the diagonal pairs (s,39-s), 4 <= s <= 18, with the additional early pair (0,9). The six-window census fixes the family at (18,21); intermediate multisets may differ. It does not classify constant-multiset windows. T2's impossibility on [4,18] holds for either reading. Other masks, source counts and characteristics are outside scope. The unrestricted depth-two exclusion remains #6141's solver result. No solver, Lean, Docker, native supplier, physical price or multiplication-theorem replay was run. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed. No kappa or selected-frontier change.

## Open next questions

- Which additional weight-3 pairs can coexist with (0,9) and [8,18]? Start from the 180 extendible states at s=8 and retain enough prefix-order information for one additional pair.
- Which analogous suffix bounds are sharp for other characteristics and source counts? The c=7 existence question is separate open work and is not taken here.

## Related open work

- #7099 proves all 2,400 T1 endpoint pairs join on [4,18] and poses the T2 question. This package answers T2 and gives all six sharp windows; its T1 count agrees.
- #7029 supplies the six c=6 families and the conditional (0,9) exclusion. This package gives its exact window threshold. The common 700 count pairs and family sizes agree.
- #7042 constructs T1 chains and counts their endpoint domains. The common endpoint counts, 120 at s=4 and 20 at s=18, agree. This package's new windows concern the other five families.
- #7043 treats (0,15) and asks about (1,14). Those early pairs are outside this package; no shared extension count is computed.
- #7016 excludes one off-diagonal replacement in the neighboring c=7 model; this package computes no c=7 quantity.
- #7032 treats two off-diagonal replacements at c=7; this package keeps c=6 fixed.
- #7037 records masks missed by a c=7 witness; no mask coverage of that word is checked here.
- #7041 gives a c=7 word realizing two missed masks; no c=7 word is computed here.
- #7045 proves cover three for two non-complement c=7 pairs; this package studies c=6 diagonal reachability instead.

Overlap was refreshed against 466 open PR bodies, this account's recent PRs, the latest 30 handoff comments, a paginated 7,089-record Discussion snapshot, targeted searches of main READMEs and merged PRs, including general-characteristic floor-word results. Sparse local-note coverage is incomplete and snapshots are non-atomic. No duplicate of this result was found within that coverage.

Completion refresh read all twelve other open account PRs created after the CLAIM: #7132, #7133, #7134, #7135, #7167, #7168, #7169, #7170, #7172, #7173, #7174 and #7175. Their objects are stock fit, dyadic guards, rectangle residual ranks, splitting tax, E8 hosting/COPY/Gram geometry, tensor Gram stabilization, commuting-stage ranks and fixed-invoice helper splitting. None studies the six-source c=6 diagonal endpoint windows or computes the same quantity. No new same-object line or numerical comparison is warranted.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** Two-way.

**Blast Radius:** Package.

One isolated research package; no shared code or selected-construction files change.
